source.price_account_derivation: program-derived address of [shard as u16 little-endian, feed id bytes] under push_oracle_program; shards 0 and 1 are listed
source.binding_rule: each entry is bound to one registry mint by exact mint equality and, for xStocks, to its registry ticker; the Pyth symbol of an underlying-share feed is exactly Equity.US.<ticker>/USD. No binding is made by name.

xstock_scaled_ui_amount.statement: One xStock display unit, the raw amount times the Token-2022 Scaled UI multiplier in effect, represents one underlying share. The value of a holding is raw / 10^decimals x multiplier x underlying share price.

evidence.finding: Scaled amount = raw amount x multiplier and reflects the equity value in underlying shares; tokens launch at multiplier 1.0 = 1 share.

For NVDAx, GOOGLx, QQQx, SPYx, COINx, HOODx, MSTRx and TSLAx the latest on-chain Pyth <xStock>/<ticker>.RR redemption rate (published 2026-07-20/21, exponent -8) agrees within 1.03 units of its last published decimal with the mint Scaled UI multiplier in effect at that publish time. No larger difference was found.
